name: io.github.rushr-dev/mcp
title: Rushr
description: Trade Robinhood Chain tokens on Uniswap and PONS curves, post callouts, read the leaderboard. Local.

environmentVariables.name: RUSHR_WALLET_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to the agent's keyfile (JSON with privateKey; Talos's .agent-wallet.json format). Use this or RUSHR_PRIVATE_KEY.

environmentVariables.name: RUSHR_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: The agent wallet's private key (0x + 64 hex). Use a fresh wallet with small funds. Never sent anywhere.

environmentVariables.name: RUSHR_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Existing rk_ API key, if the wallet is already registered and the key isn't stored next to it.

environmentVariables.name: RUSHR_DAILY_USD
environmentVariables.description: USD put into buys over any rolling 24 hours.

environmentVariables.name: RUSHR_DRY_RUN
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to build and simulate trades without ever signing or sending.
